admission.re_admission_note: PassRegistry.with_pass raises PassRegistryError for a name that is already registered, so a second admission of the same extension and pass fails before it can displace the first route.
admission.sdk_namespace_change_note: Admission is a host-side operation, so it is not added to flagquantum.ecosystem.extensions.__all__, which contracts/extension-protocol-v1-candidate.json pins as an exact set. That contract stays approved and unmodified.

pass_route.protocol_member_unchanged: flagquantum.ecosystem.extensions.sdk.CompilerPassExtension already declares transform(self, program). The registered route calls the handle rather than the extension, so the protocol member is used as declared and the SDK protocol is unchanged.
pass_route.lifecycle_bound_note: The route closes over the ExtensionHandle, so a pass invoked after its extension closed fails closed by raising ExtensionLifecycleError instead of running through a lifecycle that already ended.
pass_route.return_contract: The manager, not the crossing, checks that a pass returned a CircuitIR, and the error names the registered pass.

declaration.reserved_built_in_name_note: The host builds the registered name, always under the extension prefix, so no value an extension declares lands on a built-in name. PassRegistry independently refuses a built-in name as a second, non-overlapping check.

registry_facts.wrong_return_type_error: CompilationError naming the pass and the returned type
registry_facts.fixed_point_test: a round that removes no instruction is a fixed point

invariants: the registered name of an admitted pass always starts with the extension prefix
no extension value can produce a registered name equal to a built-in pass name
PassRegistry refuses to shadow a registered name and refuses a reserved built-in name on an otherwise empty registry
default_pass_registry resolves exactly the built-in pipeline names and no extension name
the built-in pipeline names, their order, and the number of rounds the fixed-point loop runs are unchanged by the refactor
a sequence is resolved in full before the first pass runs, so an unknown name leaves the program untouched
optimize_with_extension_pass runs the built-in pipeline to its own fixed point and then the admitted pass exactly once
the extension handle is closed even when the admitted pass or the pipeline fails

conditions.unusable_declaration: the declared pass_name is absent, empty, or not a string
conditions.non_compiler_pass_kind: the manifest kind is not compiler_pass
conditions.missing_transform_member: the extension does not implement the transform member the protocol declares
conditions.refused_negotiation: the extension reports blockers, and the error carries each one verbatim
conditions.extension_declaring_no_circuit_ir_suppor: the negotiation response does not support circuit_ir
conditions.failed_start: the extension raises while starting, and no route is left registered
conditions.sdk_incompatible_extension: the manifest api_version does not match SDK_API_VERSION, and the refusal happens before activation

builtin_path.default_path_note: fq.compile and fq.optimize resolve built-in names only. A third-party pass reaches compilation through optimize_with_extension_pass or through a caller that builds its own PassManager, never by mutating the pipeline compile is defined by.

replacement_proof.replaced_implementation: the inline nine-call fixed-point loop that previously lived in flagquantum.compiler.pipeline._optimize_to_fixed_point
replacement_proof.result_unchanged_note: The replaced loop and the manager produce the same program for the same input; the sequence is the same nine names in the same order and the round limit is the same expression.

out_of_scope.analysis_passes: CUDA-Q separates analysis passes from transformation passes. This contract defines no analysis concept, because no FlagQuantum consumer needs one yet.
out_of_scope.host_pass_manager_export: There is no public fq.PassManager. The registry and manager are Compiler-internal, and the only host-facing reach is optimize_with_extension_pass.
out_of_scope.pass_plugin_conformance_runner: run_compiler_conformance covers the compiler kind. A pass-level conformance runner is not defined here.
out_of_scope.sdk_namespace_addition: No name is added to flagquantum.ecosystem.extensions.__all__.

non_goals: A second extension registry, entry-point group, or manifest format.
Per-compilation negotiation, version checks, or extension discovery.
Moving any built-in pass body into the pass manager or into the ecosystem package.
Any change to the Stable Core exports or to the serialized execution schemas.
